items.title: Mr. X Interview, 1961-03-18
items.q: If we could get this as close as possible, Dick, when we can... Don't you think, Dick? You can take the smallest print here.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, the Jew colony. And what this has, the other don't have, you see, they took it out to MacAllister's 400 New York, you see. And the others don't have that, I don't think. That really is a rare one.

You see, this is a rare one. So you can take that. If we could get this as close as possible, Dick, when we can... Oh. There's large prints on this, even a page a piece if you could. Tulane will get these some, but I've given them my library.
Oh, that's right. I just keep these to show people, to amuse them when they come to the house here, you know. Is there any... These are the...
